title: derivations.json: every derived value as a compute tree
description: The formulas the sheet computes (d-amp-d spec §5.1): ability modifier, saves, skills, passive Perception, initiative, unarmored AC, spell save DC and attack, hit points per level, carrying capacity, the Concentration DC, and the like. Each is a display string plus a compute tree, with dependsOn as the recompute edges. A formula that needs the character's choices (which armour is worn, which class casts) names its inputs in dependsOn and leaves the choosing to the app.

display.description: The formula as a reader sees it: 8 + your spellcasting ability modifier + your Proficiency Bonus.

computeNote.description: Required when compute is absent: why a tree cannot hold it, and what the app does instead.
